title: LevelValidator
responsibility: Validate bounded level geometry and require matching human approval before gameplay.

inputs.name: LevelValidator.layout.input
inputs.description: Validate finite floor bounds, objects and clear player spawn.

inputs.name: LevelValidator.planning.input
inputs.description: Validate saved brief, bounded proposal and approval identifiers.

inputs.name: LevelValidator.isCurrent.view
inputs.description: Compare generated proposal inputs with the current brief and dimension.

inputs.name: LevelValidator.isReady.view
inputs.description: Allow legacy views or an explicitly approved and built current layout.

outputs.name: LevelValidator.layout
outputs.description: Validate finite floor bounds, objects and clear player spawn.
